crowns.ponder.nuclear_basics.text_1: Nuclear Fuel naturally produces fast neutrons
crowns.ponder.nuclear_basics.text_2: Fast neutrons are unlikely to induce fission
crowns.ponder.nuclear_basics.text_3: Add a Moderator to transform them into thermal neutrons that can induce fission and produce more neutrons
crowns.ponder.nuclear_basics.text_4: In short a moderator make the reactor hotter
crowns.ponder.nuclear_basics.text_7: Gold has the opposite effect and can be used as a control rod. It blocks every radiation
crowns.ponder.nuclear_basics.text_8: When enough fuel-type blocks are in one place with a Moderator, the reaction will skyrocket
crowns.ponder.reactor_layout.text_1: Like every hot block, hot Nuclear Fuel can be used to heat Water
crowns.ponder.reactor_layout.text_2: Construct a chess board shape out of fuel and water to optimise the use of the Moderator
crowns.ponder.reactor_layout.text_3: The taller the Reactor, the more time the water will need to boil
crowns.ponder.reactor_layout.text_4: Fuel becomes red when hotter than 3000 degrees Kelvin, and explodes at 3500
crowns.ponder.turbine.text_1: Input vapor into the Steam Inputs
crowns.ponder.turbine.text_2: If the vapor has sufficient quality (x > 0), it will be able to spin Turbines
